independence: standard library + numpy + Pillow only; no saturn / mrun / mstack / manalysis / common_harness import. All nine gate equations, the carrier promotion rule, the ledger rank score, the row ordering and the markdown rendering are re-implemented in this file.

not_independently_verifiable.why: No trajectory checkpoint tensors are retained under the results tree. The exact_scalar_replay gate and every checkpoint fingerprint are metadata declarations emitted by the same worker process that produced the numbers they attest. This auditor can confirm the declarations are internally consistent and that the gate arithmetic over them is correct; it cannot re-hash a checkpoint or re-execute a replay. Replay exactness therefore remains an unclosed metadata-based gate for the 20-axis panel, exactly as for the 12-axis panel.

The final-step register tensors are not retained, only the derived scalars. The consumer_continuation gate and the return-monotonicity half of the dose_response gate are therefore re-derivable only as arithmetic over recorded scalars, not from any retained primary evidence.

The collector retains images only for source/target/wrong_axis and for the six branches scene_dose_000/050/100, wrong_color_full, sham_full and route_ablation. The mediation rescue fractions are re-derivable as arithmetic over the two recorded MADs, but those MADs cannot be recomputed from pixels.
Images for these two dose points are not retained, so 2 of the 5 dose-curve points in the dose_response gate are scalar-only.
Recorded but unimaged. No gate consumes them, so they are reported here only for completeness.

not_independently_verifiable.item: scheduler log and staged payload hashes
not_independently_verifiable.why: Neither the raw scheduler log stream nor the staged payload archive is retained under the results tree, so these declared SHA-256 values have no recomputable input.

This auditor is CPU-only and artifact-only. It cannot establish that the retained pixels were produced by FLUX.2-klein-4B at the declared revision, nor re-run the pipeline. Nothing here upgrades the panel from 'internally consistent' to 'externally reproduced'.

not_independently_verifiable.item: independence of the retained PNGs from report.json
not_independently_verifiable.why: The on-disk PNGs are byte-identical to the base64 images embedded in report.json (this auditor verifies that). They are one artifact written twice, not two independent witnesses. Pixel-side recomputation therefore proves the recorded MAD scalars are the correct function of the recorded images; it does not prove the images are genuine.

verdict_boundary: 'consistent' means: every ledgered tier, gate verdict and gate observable re-derives exactly from the retained raw branch rows under the frozen thresholds; every recomputable declared SHA-256 matches; and every MAD-based scalar with a retained image re-derives from pixels within tolerance. It does NOT mean replay exactness was re-established -- see not_independently_verifiable.
